spans.s:
(ए) लगे r. 1st cl. (लगति)
To be with or near, to touch, to be in contact or union with.
(इ) लगि r. 1st cl. (लंगनि)
1 To go or move.
2 To go limpingly, to be lame.
r. 10th cl. (लागयति)
1 To taste.
2 To obtain.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Obtained, gained.
2 Connected with, attached to.
E.
लग to be in contact with, aff. क्त, and इट् augment.

m. (-डः)
1 A staff, a stick.
2 An iron club, or one bound with iron.
E.
लग to go, aff. डुलच्, and ल changed to ड; also लगुर.

m. (-रः)
A club, a stick.
E.
see the last; ड changed to ल.

m. (-स्तः)
A man armed with a stick, a mace or staffbearer.
E.
लगुर, and हस्त the hand.

Joined to, connected with.
n. (-ग्नं)
The rising of a sign, its appearance above the horizon; the oblique ascension, or the divisions of the equator, which rise in succession with each sign in an oblique sphere; also defined as the arc of the equator, which passes the meridian in the same time with each sign of the ecliptic; in popular acceptation it is the moment of the sun's entrance into a zodiacal sign.
m. (-ग्नः)
A bard, a panegyrist.
E.
लग to be with or near, or लस्ज to be ashamed, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
A security, a surety.
E.
लग्न engaged or associated, (in the business,) aff. कन्.

m. (-जः)
Ascensional difference.
E.
लग्न, and भुज arm.

f. (-का)
A girl ten years old, one before menstruation.
E.
लस्ज to be ashamed, aff. कन्, fem. form; also नग्निका.
